data.description: The page of results for this request.

totalCount.description: Total number of records matching the request, across all pages.

identifiersSearched.description: Count of identifiers submitted for a bulk-identifier search (e.g. bulk NPI search). Omitted/null for standard (non-bulk) list requests.

matchedCount.description: Count of submitted identifiers that matched a record. Omitted/null for standard (non-bulk) list requests.

notFoundCount.description: Count of submitted identifiers that did not match any record. Omitted/null for standard (non-bulk) list requests.

unmatchedIdentifiers.description: Submitted identifiers that did not match any record. Omitted/null for standard (non-bulk) list requests.
